run_train_grid_cell_network: run the supervised training loop for the grid cell network with configurable task and model parameters
create_place_cell_ensembles: create place cell ensembles for target generation with configurable environment size and neuron seed
create_head_direction_ensembles: create head direction cell ensembles for target generation with configurable concentration and neuron count
build_grid_cells_rnn_model: build a GridCellsRNN model with LSTM core, linear bottleneck, and dropout regularization
evaluate_grid_cell_scores: evaluate grid cell scores and generate plots for bottleneck and LSTM layer activity patterns
